lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 high-contrast vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively consistent across the mid-section with a slight reduction in interval distance toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line and the two most posterior lines are truncated, existing as dashed or abbreviated segments that do not span the full vertical height of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, situated below the termination of the vertical line series.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white spots present on the lateral muzzle/cheek; white transverse bands visible on the lower limbs immediately superior to the hooves; prominent white patch at the base of the ventral neck.
